conditions: Verify equipment requirements before equipping the staff; available charges do not establish that the wearer can equip it.
profiles.review_notes: 2026-09-24: reviewed travel function from this exact variant. Named staff bases, incidental resistance rolls and example charge capacities are planner examples, not requirements for Teleport utility. Rare staves with the same charge skill are equivalent utility candidates because the native charged suffix permits rare items. No numeric price is inferred.
